clip_script: Ayanda in Durban saves R15 a week: 15, 30, 45, 60. Same jump every time, add 15. That is a constant difference. Now a message spreads at school. Each learner tells 3 more: 1, 3, 9, 27. The jumps keep growing. Each number is 3 times the last, so the next is 81, not 33. That is a constant ratio. The water tank goes down: 1 000, 880, 760 litres, take away 120. Look at three numbers, find the jump or the times, and say the rule with its start.
visual_style: Coins dropping into a jar in equal steps, then a message spreading across a school map in bursts of three.
mood: Bright and curious, like spotting a secret code.
pacing: Steady coins, then the message speeding up, then the tank going down.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make your own pattern for a friend to crack.
